Standard: The air vehicle has the necessary response types to achieve no worse than Level 2 handling qualities within the SFE in both GVEs and DVEs. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess the air vehicle has the necessary FCS response types for both GVEs and DVEs as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Response-Types paragraph and its subparagraphs. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle has the necessary FCS response types for both GVEs and DVEs as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Response-Types paragraph and its subparagraphs. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle has the necessary FCS response types for both GVEs and DVEs as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Response-Types paragraph and its subparagraphs.
